integrity: The mathematical claim is derived from an explicit finite stationary formula and asymptotic normalization argument. Independent validation and definitive historical-priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a complete-graph stationary SIS birth–death process with recovery rate 1, pair transmission 1/n and per-node spontaneous infection alpha_n/n. It does not prove any finite-time dynamics, heterogeneous-network limit, or rate of convergence. Its exact finite-n stationary law is classical and explicitly credited; the singular logarithmic scaling statement is the proposed contribution.
title: A logarithmic importation window and random infection exponents at the critical SIS threshold
